श्री विजयपुरम: अंडमान तथा निकोबार द्वीपसमूह के उपराज्यपाल डॉ. दिनेश शर्मा ने गुरुवार, 26 नवंबर 2026 को अपराह्न श्री विजयपुरम स्थित पुनर्विकसित ‘जॉगर्स पार्क’ (Joggers Park) का विधिवत उद्घाटन कर इसे आम जनता को समर्पित किया. समारोह का शुभारंभ राष्ट्रगीत और राष्ट्रगान के साथ हुआ, जिसके पश्चात उपराज्यपाल ने उद्घाटन पट्टिका का अनावरण किया और फीता काटकर पार्क का लोकार्पण किया. स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन के अंतर्गत श्री विजयपुरम नगर पालिका परिषद द्वारा क्रियान्वित ‘ग्रीन कनेक्ट परियोजना’ (Green Connect Project) के हिस्से के रूप में इस ऐतिहासिक स्थल को मनोरंजन, स्वास्थ्य और सामुदायिक गतिविधियों के आधुनिक केंद्र के रूप में नया स्वरूप दिया गया है.
प्रकृति और विकास का संतुलन: नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस द्वीप का दिखेगा मनोरम नजारा
समारोह को संबोधित करते हुए उपराज्यपाल डॉ. दिनेश शर्मा ने कहा कि आज हम केवल एक नवीनीकृत पार्क का उद्घाटन नहीं कर रहे, बल्कि एक अधिक हरित, स्वस्थ और समावेशी शहर के निर्माण का संदेश दे रहे हैं. उन्होंने कहा कि प्रकृति ने श्री विजयपुरम को समुद्र तट, पहाड़ियों और हरियाली के रूप में अद्वितीय सौंदर्य प्रदान किया है और हमारा दायित्व है कि विकास इस प्राकृतिक विरासत का पूरक बने. नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस द्वीप, अंडमान सागर और फ्लैग पॉइंट के मनोरम दृश्यों के लिए लोकप्रिय इस पार्क में एक ऊंचा व्यूइंग डेक (Viewing Deck) भी विकसित किया गया है, जहां से समुद्री क्षेत्र का विहंगम दृश्य दिखाई देता है.
1 किमी लंबा EPDM जॉगिंग ट्रैक, फिटनेस जोन और समावेशी सुविधाएं
पार्क की आधुनिक विशेषताओं का उल्लेख करते हुए उपराज्यपाल ने बताया कि यहां लगभग एक किलोमीटर लंबा आधुनिक EPDM वॉकिंग एवं जॉगिंग ट्रैक बनाया गया है, जिसकी आरामदायक सतह वरिष्ठ नागरिकों और सभी आयु वर्ग के लोगों के लिए सुरक्षित है. इसके अतिरिक्त, पार्क में आधुनिक फिटनेस जोन, सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों व योग सत्रों के लिए मिनी स्टेज, सुव्यवस्थित उद्यान, फूलों की क्यारियां, सजावटी प्रकाश व्यवस्था और सुसज्जित बैठने की व्यवस्था की गई है. उपराज्यपाल ने पार्क में दिव्यांगजनों व सभी वर्गों की सुगम्यता (Accessibility) के लिए किए गए प्रयासों की सराहना करते हुए कहा कि किसी शहर की वास्तविक स्मार्टनेस इस बात से तय होती है कि उसकी सुविधाएं समाज के प्रत्येक वर्ग के लिए कितनी सुलभ हैं.
शाम को जुटते हैं 500 से अधिक लोग, स्वच्छता बनाए रखने की अपील
उपराज्यपाल ने प्रसन्नता व्यक्त की कि शाम के व्यस्त समय में यहां आगंतुकों की संख्या 500 से अधिक हो जाती है. उन्होंने जॉगर्स पार्क को गांधी पार्क से जोड़ने वाली ग्रीन कनेक्ट परियोजना की सराहना करते हुए नगर पालिका परिषद से नियमित रखरखाव और स्वच्छता को सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता देने का आग्रह किया, साथ ही नागरिकों से भी पार्क को अपने घर की तरह स्वच्छ रखने की अपील की. इस अवसर पर सांसद बिष्णु पद रे, श्री विजयपुरम नगर पालिका परिषद की अध्यक्षा एम. वसंथा, दक्षिण अंडमान की उपायुक्त, पुलिस अधीक्षक, नगर पालिका परिषद के पार्षदगण तथा अन्य वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित रहे.
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

MUQDISHO, Soomaaliya — Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga labada dal, gaar ahaan dhinacyada ganacsiga, caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo adeegyada qunsuliyadda.
Wasiiru-Dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar, ayaa kulan laba geesood ah la yeeshay Wasiiru-Dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Hindiya, Pabitra Margherita.
Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan ee ay wadaagaan Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya.
Labada mas’uul ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay hirgelinta heshiiskii is-afgaradka ahaa ee hore loogu saxiixay magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo saldhig u noqonaya horumarinta iskaashiga iyo xiriirka labada dowladood.
Intii uu kulanku socday, labada dhinac ayaa isla soo qaaday sameynta guddiyo farsamo oo wadajir ah, kuwaas oo qaabilsanaan doona isku dubbaridka iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada ganacsiga, caafimaadka, arrimaha qunsuliyadda iyo waxbarashada.
Guddiyadan ayaa la filayaa inay door ka qaataan sidii loo aqoonsan lahaa fursadaha iskaashi ee labada dal, loo dardargelin lahaa fulinta heshiisyada jira, isla markaana loo xaqiijin lahaa in qorshayaasha la isla meel dhigay ay isu beddelaan mashaariic iyo waxqabad muuqda.
Labada mas’uul ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in heshiisyada iyo is-afgaradyada ay labada dal kala saxiixdeen aanay ku ekaan qoraallo iyo ballanqaadyo diblomaasiyadeed, balse loo beddelo waxqabad miro-dhal ah oo faa’iido u leh shacabka Soomaaliya iyo Hindiya.
Kulankan ayaa muujinaya dadaallada ay labada dowladood ku doonayaan inay sii xoojiyaan xiriirkooda, iyagoo mudnaan siinaya iskaashi wax-ku-ool ah oo ka hirgala dhinacyada muhiimka u ah horumarka labada dal.

Perth summer forecast: BoM warns of heatwaves and record heat, but beachgoers say ‘the tan comes first’
Temperature records are likely to be broken this summer with Perth in line for “extreme heat and heatwaves” — but beachgoers say that won’t stop them from hitting the sand.
An unusually warm season has been predicted in the Bureau of Meteorology’s long-range forecast, released this week, and climatologist Caitlin Minney is tipping records to tumble.
“On average across summer it is very likely to be warmer than average for Perth,” she said.
“80 per cent or greater of maximum and minimum temperatures are expected to fall in the top 20 per cent of records. We refer to that as unusually warm temperatures.
“Compared to previous Decembers there’s a 60 per cent chance of maximum temperatures being unusually warm and January is really similar so the average across summer is consistently unusually warm.”
But not even the proespect of a long-strech of 40C days could deter 21-year-old sun-lover Ella Allison, who said that extreme weather sounds “exciting”.
“I would still come to the beach, the tan comes first,” she joked.
“I think whenever it’s warm enough I will always come which at the moment is at least once a week so I’m excited it will be hot this summer and I can come so much more.”
Lena Lurger agreed.
“I would rather be out in the heat than stay inside, even if its going to be really hot,” the 23-year-old said.
“I love spending hours at the beach it’s so nice here. I don’t think extreme heat will stop me, I’ll just apply more sunscreen and swim lots to cool down.”
While Ellen Carlsson said extreme heat could be off putting, Perth’s summer sun was what drew here to Australia.
“I just want to be in the sun as much as possible because I’m from Sweden but maybe if it gets too hot I will get tired of it,” the 25-year-old said.
Irespective of the predicted heat Cancer Council WA Cancer Prevention and Research Director Melissa Ledger urged caution this summer.
She said people shouldn’t use the temperature or how hot it feels to gauge whether or not they need sun protection.

Six Greek regions have been placed under the highest level of civil protection mobilization (red code) through Sunday as severe weather brings flooding, landslides and transport disruption, particularly in the Ionian Islands and western Greece.
The National Meteorological Service (EMY) upgraded its severe weather bulletin to an emergency warning for dangerous weather phenomena on Friday, forecasting heavy rain and thunderstorms across an expanding area of the country.
The Ionian Islands, Epirus and western Greece are under red code status on Friday and Saturday, while Thessaly, central Greece and the Peloponnese will follow on Sunday.

Corfu Hit by Torrential Rain, Flooding and Landslides
Corfu, an Ionian island off northwestern Greece, has experienced serious problems following hours of continuous rainfall, with flooded roads, fallen trees and landslides reported in several areas. Dozens of homes lost electricity on Thursday evening, while transport services were also disrupted.
Rainfall reached nearly 200 millimeters in parts of southern Corfu, equivalent to approximately 200 liters per square meter. Private weather stations recorded 197.6 mm in Chlomos and 192.8 mm in Perivoli, both villages in the island’s southern end, according to state broadcaster ERT.
In Epirus, northwest mainland Greece, a weather station in Grika, Thesprotia prefecture, recorded 141.99 mm of rain, with intensity reaching 15 mm per hour.
In Lefkimmi, southeast Corfu, stream levels rose significantly, while sections of the road network were flooded. Rockfalls and fallen trees were also reported.

Storms to spread across mainland Greece
According to EMY, heavy rain and thunderstorms will continue on Saturday in the Ionian Islands, Epirus and western central Greece, while western Peloponnese will also be affected. From Saturday evening, the storms are expected to spread to parts of central Macedonia, particularly Pieria and Halkidiki prefectures, north of Thessaloniki, and eastern Thessaly.
On Sunday, the main areas at risk will be Thessaly, eastern central Greece, particularly Fthiotida, and the large island of Evia. The storms will gradually extend to eastern and southern Peloponnese.
Very strong northerly to northeasterly winds are also forecast in eastern Greece, reaching nine on the Beaufort scale and locally 10 in the Aegean.
112 Alert for Messolonghi, fire brigade on standby
A warning was sent through the 112 emergency system to residents of Messolonghi, a coastal town in western Greece, urging them to restrict travel to essential journeys and follow official instructions.
The fire brigade has been placed on heightened alert, with its operational plan for floods and related hazards activated. The National Coordination Center for Operations and Crisis Management (ESKEDIK) is coordinating with regional and municipal authorities, which have been instructed to assess their readiness and convene civil protection coordination bodies.
The civil protection general aecretariat has urged residents to avoid unnecessary travel, stay away from flooded roads and streams and secure objects that could be swept away by strong winds.
The main risks through Sunday include flash flooding, landslides, damage to road infrastructure and transport disruption.

Squishies! Kids love them and can’t get enough. Packs of kids roam the streets at all hours of the night, seeking their next squishy fix. Meanwhile, everything with a Needoh logo on it is sold out everywhere, or only available for jacked-up prices from scalpers.
Here’s a potential solution: Right now Woot is running a Black Friday toy sale that includes lots of squishies on sle for over 50% off. They’re not Needoh brand, but they squish and they’re on sale. And if your kids are young enough, they won’t know the difference anyway. Better yet, if you enter promo code BIGFRIDAY, you’ll get an extra 20% off the already-discounted rate. And if you’ve never made a purchase from Woot, you’ll get 30% off. The sale ends December 7, but the promo code only lasts until November 29.
Woot, for those who don’t follow such things, is a subsidiary of Amazon, so it’s legit. You can even use your Amazon login credentials to complete the purchase using your saved method of payment. Woot often has items on clearance for deeply discounted prices. But stock doesn’t tend to last very long, so grab what you want sooner rather than later.
So what kinds of squishies are we talking about? Squishy butter sticks are available on sale. A butter and dumpling combo pack is 53% off, before the extra promo code deal. You can get squishy holiday dumplings, squishy holiday cubes, squishy cheese, bananas, and watermelon. There’s plenty available, and it’s not going to squish itself. These make excellent stocking stuffers if nothing else.
Sure, some of them have tacky surfaces that will collect dust and lint. Some will inevitably be popped by wretched children and make a mess on the carpet or couch. That’s just life. And no, they’re not Needoh brand, but unless you get lucky at a brick-and-mortar store, you’re probably not going to find any Needoh squishies at MSRP anywhere before Christmas. These are discounted squishies that you can actually buy right now – and that's good enough for me.
